sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP exploring strategic alternatives. Gold miners counter-cyclical strength on safe-haven demand and multiple ASX junior discoveries.
sectors.implications: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore weakness. Overweight gold names (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX, STO.AX gold exposure) and juniors (Aureka, Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto).

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rate-hike bets compress net interest margins and raise credit-loss concerns amid property downturn.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face headwinds from hawkish RBA and property stress. Monitor NIM and NPL trends closely.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation and Houthi strikes spike oil; Santos gas cartel breaking reduces pricing power for STO.AX.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX benefit from oil spike short-term. STO.AX faces structural gas margin pressure. LNG names (GAS.AX, QGN.AX) mixed.

sectors.trend: Buyer sentiment at new lows; 'GFC moment' narrative; NZ house price crash echoes. Construction capacity deficit compounds supply issues.
sectors.implications: Defensive posture on REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) and property developers. WES.AX, WBC.AX mortgage books under stress.

sectors.trend: Mortgage costs forcing second-job participation; car supply crunch raises insurance premiums; 102-year-old retailer closes 25 stores.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDW.AX, CSG.AX face margin pressure. Defensive consumer staples (WOW.AX, SGP.AX) relatively resilient.

sectors.trend: Limited ASX-specific headlines. ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute signals regulatory risk for tech. CSL.AX steady as defensive.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive exposure. ATO enforcement may pressure listed tech/medtech margins.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and property developers; favour fixed-income ladders.
Underweight REITs and construction; monitor NAB/CBA mortgage NPL data.
Hedge with energy long (WDS, WLE) but watch for volatility spike; reduce AUD exposure.
Rotate out BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX into gold and diversified miners.
Favour defensive staples (WOW, SGP); avoid discretionary consumer exposure.
Monitor STO.AX gas contract renewals; diversify energy exposure.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely under pressure: hawkish RBA, property stress, and iron ore weakness dominate. Oil spike provides partial offset via energy names. Expect volatility around RBA communications and geopolitical headlines. Sentiment score 36/100.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift from iron ore to gold and energy transition. Property correction may extend 6–12 months. Living standards squeeze pressures consumer spending. Gold and defensive sectors outperform; iron ore and property underperform. RBA likely to hold or hike, keeping rates elevated.
